51 weeks + 7 days = 51*7 + 7 = 357 + 7 = 364 days.  
364 days = 52 weeks exactly, which is exactly 1 year in the Gregorian calendar only if no leap day is crossed.  
1204 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100 unless divisible by 400; 1204 divisible by 4, not by 100).  
Start date 1204-09-13. Adding 364 days:  
From 1204-09-13 to 1205-09-12 is 365 days (because 1204 is leap, but Feb 29 is before Sep 13, so 1204-09-13 to 1205-09-13 is 365 days).  
We need 364 days: 1204-09-13 + 364 days = 1205-09-12.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1205-09-12
